column1: # Committed floor of io ids a release must prove: `id<TAB>package` (repo-relative).
# Generated by `go run ./cmd/ioe2e release-ids`. Every other expected set in this
# tool shrinks when its input shrinks — deleting a `// io:<id>` marker would
# silently delete the obligation. A tracked file cannot shrink at run time, so
# retiring or moving an id is a reviewed commit, not a side effect.
